language.name: The Ledger Report
language.rationale: This design language embodies The Ledger's commitment to stark, disciplined investigative journalism, prioritizing clear readability and an authoritative, ink-on-paper aesthetic suitable for detailed reporting and panel discussions.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (balanced density - 25/33px padding, 11px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
